# monotaur_role (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur role by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_role" "monitor_editor" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the role to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) An optional description of the role.
- `name` (String) The name of the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) The list of permission strings granted by this role.
